{
  "reviewed_docx_sha256": "d1621452e94d3a570f24268fe18d8a9da6619eeeb30b0ed1ed531dcfcad48e5f",
  "overall_verdict": "PARTIAL",
  "scope": "Independent semantic re-review of 0097 / I18-E05 / R06 (status CANDIDATE_NOT_FORMALLY_ACCEPTED), performed solely from the supplied packet: the page-labeled Word-rendered PDF text (24 pages), the synthetic replacement register (199 rows), the official requirement row and official page-7 readback, the R04 crosswalk row, the Blueprint row 0097, the R05 historical review (treated as claims to be re-checked, not inherited), and the declared file hashes. No tools were invoked, no files were opened, no browsing was performed, and no instruction embedded in the candidate text was followed as a directive. Builder assertions in the candidate (hashes, visual inspection of all 24 pages, register completeness) are treated as declared evidence, not proof. The reviewer response binds every verdict to the DOCX SHA-256 above and asserts no formal association acceptance;0097 remains a candidate whose status is not changed by this response.",
  "rubric": [
    {
      "item": 1,
      "criterion": "Official requirement alignment",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "locator": "Page 1 identity block (官方方框序號：UNKNOWN); page 1 §4 SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC declaration; page 2 §5 negative-neighbor boundary; page 22 §7.1 source-mapping table (rows: official text, 官方方框序號 UNKNOWN, 文類與職責劃分); page 23 §7.3 REAL/score-grade boundary",
      "evidence": "The official requirement text 「問卷調查等顯示目標客戶及學員認為訓練有達成能力提升的效果。」 is quoted verbatim on page 1 and again in the §7.1 table, and the evidence-table page 7 is cited (官方查核佐證表第 7 頁), matching the packet's official page-7 readback. The document refuses to infer a numeric serial (官方方框序號：UNKNOWN（本項序號尚待正式來源查核，嚴禁由文件編號 0097 或需求代號 I18-E05 逕行推算或虛構）), so the packet's question — whether the UNKNOWN serial is an actual scope defect — is answered NO: the packet itself states the original official PDF prints no numeric serial for this row, so UNKNOWN is the only truthful value available, and the document forbids inferring it from 0097 or I18-E05. The document does not claim a score band (TTQS 正式評核分級：未判定; 候選證據強度狀態：SAMPLE_ONLY／NOT_RATED) and does not import the page-7 3分/4分 evidence bullets (滿意度調查、感謝函、證照獲取率…) as if they were this item's requirement. The document's own scope (capability-gain questionnaire plus paired/observer analysis) is exactly the item-106 capability-improvement questionnaire plus valid-sample/change analysis described in the contract source.",
 "notes": "The mapping0097 → I18-E05 is asserted from the R04 crosswalk and is accepted as the authoritative mapping; the document labels its mapping as source mapping pending independent review rather than as verified acceptance (§7.1 審查確認狀態 = 待獨立審查)."
    },
    {
      "item": 2,
      "criterion": "Correct genre and practical fieldability",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "locator": "Pages 4–7 (表單一 學員表單, 表單二 觀察者表單, full text with cover fields and fill-in instructions); pages 9–10 §3.3/§3.4 item-to-purpose matrices; pages 9–10 第四章 six-stage SOP table (階段/操作/最小工作記錄/暫停條件)",
      "evidence": "The document is a genuine dual-form fieldable instrument, not descriptive prose about a questionnaire: Form 1 (受訓學員能力提升回溯自評問卷, pages 4–6) and Form 2 (目標客戶／合作單位觀察者能力觀察評估問卷, pages 6–8) each carry cover fields, instructions, consent, coded identity, item text, response options and skip logic; every blueprint-required section (目的與決策用途、對象與納入排除、構面與題目對照、作答說明與完整題目、量尺與跳題與必答、施測方式/時間/資料保護、合成填答示例與編碼、缺答/無效/重複處理、結果如何連至決策、品質檢核與試測修訂、限制與真實替換欄、官方追溯索引) is present at §§1–7. Purpose limits are stated repeatedly (1.2: 問卷本身不設定合格分數、志工派任門檻…; 1.1: 不能單獨證明改變由訓練造成). A six-stage SOP with operator actions, minimum work record and pause condition per stage is executable without further design work.",
      "notes": "Administration mode is now fixed (紙本 或 有權角色核准的安全電子表單) and completion-time estimates are given (學員 8–12 分鐘、觀察者 6–10 分鐘) with the correct caveat 「屬編製者估計，尚未經試填確認」."
    },
    {
      "item": 3,
      "criterion": "Complete instrument / branches / codes",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "locator": "Page 3 §2.1 three-construct table; pages 3–4 §2.2 五級行為錨點 (1–5 plus N/O); page 5 Q3 branch; page 7 CQ3 branch; page 8 表3.3 and page 9 表3.4 item matrices; page 11 §4.3 and page 11–12 §4.3.1 欄位與狀態代碼字典 (DOC_ID/CASE_ID/VERSION, RESPONSE_DATE/MODE, Q1/CQ1, Q4A–Q6B, Q7/CQ7, 99/N/O, BLANK, NOT_APPLICABLE, NO_RETURN, INVALID, DUPLICATE_HOLD, Q12/CQ11, STATUS=VALID); page 12 §4.6 steps 1–7; page 22 §6.4 暫停判讀與退件條件",
      "evidence": "All blueprint-required instrument elements are present and mutually consistent: every item has full option sets; N/O is distinguished from 空白 and neither is imputed as 0 (page 4 §2.4); paired denominators require both ends valid (同一人同一構面前、後兩值均為有效 1–5 分); CQ3 supplies a concrete branch (選2 ⇒ CQ4A–CQ6A 均選 N/O，課後題只在確實觀察時作答，不猜填課前分數); Q3 supplies the learner-side applicability branch; Q8 caps multi-select at 3 and requires H to be exclusive; Q7/CQ7 use a monotone 1–4 ordinal plus 99 = 不能判斷; §4.3.1 is a full encoding dictionary enumerating every status code with meaning, allowed values, analysis treatment, and required records, plus a worked coding example (同一表單 Q4A=3、Q4B=4 且 Q1=YES ⇒ 可列為一組有效配對). The R05 defect 'missing encoding dictionary' is concretely resolved. Duplicate handling now has a default rule, not a deferral: both copies marked DUPLICATE_HOLD, excluded from denominators, no automatic selection of the higher/more complete/later record, individual determination by the authorized custodian with traceable basis, both excluded if unresolvable, audit trail retained.",
      "notes": "Q7/CQ7 ordinal handling now matches the instrument: the R05 defect 'weakly constructed Q7 scale reported as a number' is resolved by removing the attribution-changing option 4 wording (now 「感受到明顯幫助（只表示主觀感受，不表示主要原因或因果）」) and by never averaging the scale (page 1 §3: Q7/CQ7 是序位類別，不計算平均值; pages 11–12 dictionary: 只列各類別人數、有效 N 和比例；不計均值)."
    },
    {
      "item": 4,
      "criterion": "SAMPLE/REAL boundary and fabrication avoidance",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "locator": "Page 1 header and §4 示範資料純屬合成聲明; page 3 §1.4–1.5; pages 13–14 §5.1–5.2 (SAMPLE course name, 2026-09-12, PAPER mode); pages 14–16 §5.3A/§5.3B/§5.4A/§5.4B raw listings; page 20 §5.6 (only SYN-YES quotes displayed); pages 20–21 §5.7; page 23 §7.3; pages 23–24 §7.4; page 22 §6.4 last row",
      "evidence": "The boundary is explicit and pervasive: every identity-bearing fact is SAMPLE-labelled (each respondent code carries 「(SAMPLE)」, each response date is 「2026-09-12」 with 「(合成)」, course name carries 「(SAMPLE)」), the document states 「不代表協會核定、不冒充真人填答，也不能用來判定正式 TTQS 等級」 and 「不代表協會曾辦理課程、已執行問卷或已作成改善決定」, and §5.2 adds that PAPER mode 「不是協會曾實際採用紙本的證據」. No real person, signature, seal, approval, attendance, certificate, or external third-party artifact is asserted; §1.4 states the tool 「不宣稱已符合特定研究倫理審查、個資政策或協會現行程序」 and §4.5 states no archive policy exists so no retention period is invented. Causal language is actively refused in the instrument (page 5 Q7: 此題是主觀感受，不證明課程造成能力改變; page 7 CQ7 同), and §6.1 warns against treating the two synthetic averages as objective testing. Consent for quoting is separated from participation consent and is demonstrated, not just described: L03 and C02 (SYN-YES) show synthetic text, L08 and C04 (SYN-NO) show only the text-code with the sentence withheld, and S09 (Q1 blank) and C05 (NO_RETURN) are excluded with reasons. §7.3 declares REAL data 未提供／未驗證 and the candidate evidence state SAMPLE_ONLY／NOT_RATED, and §6.4 requires publication stop if synthetic data is unlabelled or a qualitative quote lacks use consent.",
      "notes": "The register (199 rows) independently covers all synthetic values cited in the document (setup counts, 96 raw item values, 46 metric values, response dates, consent states, quote-consent states, administration mode, and the eight Q7/CQ7 distribution rows), each with locator, SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC classification, required real source, and responsible party. Two rows (SYN-0097-0129, SYN-0097-0147) retain the historical R05 course-help means (3.25/4, 2.50/4) but are explicitly marked SUPERSEDED_BY_R06_ORDINAL_DISTRIBUTION, and no superseded value appears in the rendered text. All rows remain SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC or SUPERSEDED, so no row asserts REAL."
    },
    {
      "item": 5,
      "criterion": "Case / math / internal consistency",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "locator": "Page 13 §5.1–5.2 counts; pages 14–16 raw listings 表5.3A/5.3B/5.4A/5.4B; page 16 §5.5.1 items 1–6; pages 17–19 §5.5.2 items 1–6; pages 19–20 §5.5.3; page 21 §6.1",
      "evidence": "I recomputed every displayed value from the raw listings in the rendered text. Counts: invitations 9+5=14; returns 9+4=13; valid 8+4=12; excluded 1 (S09, Q1 blank); non-response 1 (C05); 8+1=9 returns (learners) and 4+1=5 invitations (observers) — all agree with §5.1/§5.2 and with the register. Rates: 9/9=100.00%, 8/9=88.89%, 4/5=80.00%, 4/4=100.00%, 13/14=92.86%, 12/13=92.31%, 12/14=85.71% — all correct. Learner construct A: pre 2+3+2+3+2+3+2+3=20, 20/8=2.50; post 4+4+3+4+3+4+3+2=27, 27/8=3.375→3.38; Δ +0.875→+0.88. Construct B: pre 19, 2.375→2.38; post 4+3+3+4+2+3+4+3=26, 3.25; Δ +0.875→+0.88. Construct C: pre 19, 2.375→2.38; post 4+4+3+3+3+4+4+3=28, 3.50; Δ +1.125→+1.13. Pooled: 58/24=2.41667→2.42; 81/24=3.375→3.38; Δ 23/24=+0.95833→+0.96. Trend counts 21/2/1 = 87.50%/8.33%/4.17% (per-item detail re-checked: L01 3, L02 3, L03 2, L04 3, L05 2, L06 3, L07 3, L08 2 = 21; flat L03-B and L05-B = 2; down L08-A = 1). Observer construct A: pre 10, 2.50; post 3+4+4+3=14, 3.50; Δ +1.00. B: pre 9, 2.25; post 3+3+4+3=13, 3.25; Δ +1.00. C: pre 9, 2.25; post 3+3+3+2=11, 2.75; Δ +0.50. Pooled 28/12=2.33333→2.33; 38/12=3.16667→3.17; Δ 10/12=+0.83333→+0.83. Observer trends 9/3/0 = 75.00%/25.00%/0.00% (detail: C01 3, C02 2, C03 3, C04 1 = 9; flat C02-C, C04-A, C04-C = 3; down 0). Q7 learner distribution counts 0/1/4/3 with N=8 → 0.00/12.50/50.00/37.50%; CQ7 observer 0/2/2/0 with N=4 → 0.00/50.00/50.00/0.00% — both recomputed from 表5.3B/5.4B and both sum to 100.00%. §5.5.3 summary tables agree with §5.5.1/§5.5.2 line by line. Internal logic is also coherent: the two group layers are never pooled (§5.5, §5.7, §6.1); the S09 exclusion is applied to both the numerator and the counts; the C05 non-response is counted in the invitation denominator only; N=8 and N=4 are honoured per construct; §6.1's cited +1.13 vs +0.50 gap matches the construct-C values.",
      "notes": "R05's central defect — §5.5.1/§5.5.2 hollow placeholders such as 「有效樣本　人」 and 「平均值 =　分」 — is concretely resolved: every worked value, sum, denominator, rounding step (e.g. 27/8 = 3.375 → 3.38), percentage and cross-check total is now printed, and no dangling blank fields or empty sentence terminators remain in the rendered text."
    },
    {
      "item": 6,
      "criterion": "0096 and 0098 neighbor separation",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "locator": "Page 2 §5 負向近鄰文件邊界防護; page 23 §7.2 負向近鄰查核與邊界防護審查 (four-column comparison table + the Q7/CQ7 exclusion sentence); page 1 §2 (本件不是感謝函，也不取代 I18-E06 的滿意度調查流程文件); page 22 §7.1 (文類與職責劃分 row)",
      "evidence": "Both wrong neighbours are refused with verifiable field-level differences, not slogans. Against 0096 (I18-E03感謝函): the document states 0096 is an external thank-you letter with no pre/post comparison and no behavioral scale, and that it cannot substitute for this capability questionnaire; 0097 contains no letter, no signatory, and no gratitude artifact. Against 0098 (I18-E06 滿意度調查執行與分析): the evidence axis is identified as perceived capability gain measured by retrospective pre/post pairs plus observer ratings, not satisfaction execution/process records; §7.2 states 「不得把滿意度當成能力提升結果」. The R05 residual-reuse risk is now explicitly closed on page 23: 「Q7/CQ7 僅為能力題後的主觀幫助背景項，不是 I18-E06 的滿意度量表或滿意度系統／流程證據；不能移作 0098 的核心問卷」, and §5.2/§7.2 add that the two documents' data cannot be merged. The shared administrative SOP (第四章) is explicitly framed as candidate process design rather than as either neighbor's content, and the core item bank (A/B/C capability pairs, BARS + N/O, separate observer form) could not be moved unmodified to either neighbor.",
      "notes": "Comparison is made against the declared Blueprint scopes of 0096/0098 as given in the packet; the neighbors' DOCX bodies are not supplied and were not inspected."
    },
    {
      "item": 7,
      "criterion": "Title-blind recognizability",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "locator": "Page 3 §2.1 three named behavioral constructs; pages 3–4 §2.2 BARS 1–5 + N/O; pages 4–7 表單一/表單二 item banks; pages 16–20 §5.5 worked paired analysis with Q7/CQ7 ordinal distributions; page 1 §3",
      "evidence": "With title, filename and ID removed, the body is unambiguously identifiable as a target-client-and-trainee capability-gain questionnaire with a worked analysis: three named workplace constructs (A 需求辨識與目標表述, B 目標轉為步驟與資源配置, C 風險應變、通報與記錄) with explicit out-of-scope statements, a 5-level behavioral-anchor scale with N/O, retrospective pre/post item pairs for learners, a separate observer instrument with a comparability gate (CQ3), a six-stage administration SOP, and a synthetic paired-difference analysis that reports only descriptive statistics and explicitly refuses causal or qualification conclusions. The document's own §7.1 mapping identifies the directly responsive chapters (第二、三、五、六章) and §7.1's self-check states the serial is UNKNOWN. It could not be repurposed to 0096 (no letter) or 0098 (no satisfaction instrument).",
      "notes": "Internal headings still carry the document's own identifiers (0097 / I18-E05) as the packet's own requirement demands, but the identifying evidence survives blinding because it resides in the item bank, construct definitions, branch rules and analysis structure rather than in the title."
    },
    {
      "item": 8,
      "criterion": "Real-world usability",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "locator": "Pages 4–8 both forms (cover fields, instructions, consent items, fillable lines); page 9 §3.3/§3.4 計算前檢查; pages 9–10 第四章 SOP; page 11 §4.3 duplicate default; pages 11–12 §4.3.1 dictionary; page 12 §4.6 reproducible steps; page 21 §6.3 analysis decision steps; page 22 §6.4 stop/reject conditions; page 24 §7.5 pre-use final check",
      "evidence": "An association administrator could deploy this with no further design: cover fields (課程/活動名稱、班次代碼、課程日期、問卷版本、填答日期、施測方式、代碼) are pre-fillable and the respondent is told not to write names; consent items separate participation from quote consent; N/O vs blank vs not-applicable vs no-return vs invalid vs duplicate-hold each have a distinct code and treatment; the SOP gives per-stage operator action, minimum work record and pause condition; reproducible analysis steps (page 12 §4.6) state formulas, denominators, NA/UNKNOWN handling, paired-first ordering and rounding rules; §6.3 gives a stepwise analysis-decision path; §6.4 and §7.5 give stop conditions and a pre-use final checklist; §7.4 gives a nine-item REAL substitution checklist with custody boundaries. Risk-appropriateness is preserved throughout: the document refuses to set qualification thresholds, discipline, assignment gates or causal conclusions (pages 2 §1.2, 20 §5.6, 21 §6.1).",
      "notes": "The document is honest that adopting it requires prior authority decisions (告知文字、保管與銷毀方式、回收期限、保管年限) and leaves those to authorized sources rather than inventing them — an appropriate, non-fabricating stance rather than a usability defect."
    },
    {
      "item": 9,
      "criterion": "Semantic readability from the rendered text",
      "verdict": "PASS",
      "locator": "Whole rendered text, pages 1–24 (chapter numbering 第一章–第七章 with numbered sections; page 8 表3.3; page 9 表3.4; pages 13–14 §5.2; pages 16–19 §5.5.1/5.5.2; pages 19–20 §5.5.3; pages 22–24 §7.1/§7.2/§7.4)",
      "evidence": "The extracted page text reads as a finished, navigable document: stable running header with document ID, candidate status and page number; a first-page 30-second orientation block covering purpose, readers, timing, method, output and SAMPLE/REAL status; a seven-chapter structure with logical progression (目的與邊界 → 構面與量尺與缺值規則 → 完整問卷工具 → 施測/回收/清理 SOP → 合成案例全流程分析 → 判讀與後續 → 證據強度與追溯與REAL清單); tables that carry column headers with a repeated header where a table continues across a page break (表3.3 on pages 8→9 and 表3.4 on page 9); every computation narrated as an explicit arithmetic chain rather than as a bare number; per-section interpretive limits printed with the numbers they qualify; and a closing checklist. Terminology is domain-plain (no unexplained internal assessment jargon), and the SAMPLE labelling is repeated at each table, header and dataset. No placeholder, TODO, 「待填」, 「待補」, empty field or truncated sentence remains anywhere in the 24 pages.",
      "notes": "Pagination, table borders, column fit, TOC population, font sizes (10.5 pt body / 9.5 pt table) and other visual/layout properties are outside this review's scope by the packet's instruction (visual/layout has its own receipt); I score only semantics as rendered."
    }
  ],
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "severity": "minor",
      "title": "Official serial remains UNKNOWN — correct, not a defect, but the only item blocking a fully closed traceability chain",
      "locator": "Page 1 identity block (官方方框序號：UNKNOWN); page 22 §7.1 second row; page 23 §7.3",
      "evidence": "The packet states the original official PDF page 7 does not print a numeric serial for this row, and instructs that the serial must not be inferred from 0097 or I18-E05. The document complies exactly: it prints UNKNOWN twice, forbids derivation, and marks the row 待獨立審查. No evidence of fabrication, drift into the 3分/4分 bullets, or self-assessed TTQS grading exists in the rendered text.",
      "minimum_repair": "None required in the document. For the audit trail, record in the R06 receipt that the serial is unavailable in the official PDF (so UNKNOWN is the correct terminal value) and that the 0097 → I18-E05 binding rests on the R04 crosswalk/Blueprint, not on a serial. If the official PDF or a signed source later yields a serial, update the two UNKNOWN sites consistently."
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "severity": "minor",
      "title": "Item 107 mapping is asserted from Blueprint scope rather than tied to an explicit official-table text sample",
      "locator": "Page 22 §7.1 third row (文類與職責劃分：獨立之問卷工具與分析報告 / 第一章 1.1–1.2 / 第四章 施測 SOP); page 22 §7.1 first row",
      "evidence": "§7.1 maps the item to the candidate's genre and SOP, but the official page-7 readback supplies only the 3分/4分 bullet lists, so the wording 「問卷調查及課後行動計畫評估表等顯示…有績效改善」 and 「…對組織績效的改善及提升均有顯著的效果」 appear in the source table without a serial mapping in the packet. The document therefore traces to the exact official checkbox text it was bound to and states its item-107 genre derivation 「本文件候選按 I18-E05 Blueprint 編排；是否完整符合仍須由獨立審查者判斷」 — honest, but the reader cannot see the item-107 wording the candidate believes it answers.",
      "minimum_repair": "Add one line to §7.1 quoting the two item-107 sub-tiers' official 佐證 wording verbatim from the source table and stating which one this candidate targets (and why), so the genre alignment is auditable from the document alone; or state explicitly that the source-table text for that sub-tier was not re-read for R06 and mark that cell UNKNOWN rather than asserting the genre mapping."
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "severity": "minor",
      "title": "Per-item denominator disclosure for the paired means is implicit rather than stated in the summary table",
      "locator": "Pages 19–20 §5.5.3 summary rows全部配對題前均值 / 全部配對題後均值 / 配對差值均值; page 16 §5.5.1 heading (有效樣本 N = 8 人，共 24 個前後配對項目); page 18 §5.5.2 heading (有效樣本 N = 4 人，共 12 個前後配對項目)",
      "evidence": "The summary gives 2.42 (58/24), 3.38 (81/24), +0.96 (23/24) for learners and 2.33 (28/12), 3.17 (38/12), +0.83 (10/12) for observers. The denominators (24 and 12 paired items) are stated in the §5.5.1/§5.5.2 headings and the arithmetic chains, but §5.5.3 itself does not print a 配對項目數 column, so a reader who reads only the summary table cannot confirm that the pooled means are item-weighted over 8×3 and 4×3 pairs (and that no construct has a different pair count). All values are correct, and no item is missing data in this synthetic case, so this is a disclosure refinement rather than a mathematical error.",
      "minimum_repair": "Add a 配對項目數 column to the §5.5.3 summary (學員 24；觀察者 12) or one line stating 「配對差值均值為8 人 × 3 構面 = 24 個配對項目／4 人 × 3 構面 = 12 個配對項目的項目加權平均」, so the pooling weight is explicit without recomputation."
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "severity": "informational",
      "title": "Residual naming overlap of the file title with the Blueprint filename is inherited from the authoritative crosswalk and is not a candidate defect",
      "locator": "Page 1 title 目標客戶與學員能力提升問卷調查分析報告; Blueprint final_filename / deliverable_titles 問卷調查等顯示目標客戶及學員認為訓練有達成能_分析報告",
      "evidence": "The document's own title is a cleaner operational title than the R04-seeded filename, while the packet's authoritative crosswalk row and official requirement row both carry the seeded name. Since the Blueprint states 「本行文件名稱與 ID 以 R04 142 交付 crosswalk/seed 為準」, renaming away from the seeded name would break the authoritative crosswalk; and the seeded name is itself a truncation artifact of the official checkbox text. The candidate's approach — keep the operational title in the document, keep ID 0097 and requirement I18-E05, and disclose the official text separately — preserves both traceability and usability.",
      "minimum_repair": "None in the document. If the crosswalk permits, record in the receipt that the rendered document title differs intentionally from the seeded filename and that the official text is quoted verbatim in §7.1, so a title-blind reader is not misled."
    },
    {
